banner.title: Is this receipt genuine?
banner.lead: Scan the QR code on the receipt or enter the booking number and verification code — payment details are shown straight from our system.

valid.title: Receipt is genuine
valid.text: This payment is confirmed in the Ravon Travel system.
valid.note: Compare the paper receipt with these details. If any field differs, the receipt may have been altered — please contact us.

invalid.title: No such receipt
invalid.text: The booking number or verification code is wrong, or the payment is not confirmed. Check the details again — if the problem persists, contact a manager.

form.title: Enter the details
form.hint: Both are printed on the receipt next to the QR code.
